Add the trusted repository policy validator.

## Changes

- Validate immutable approval and review receipts.

## Impact

- User/runtime: policy failures become visible before merge
- API/schema/dependencies: adds the repository policy contract
- Operations/deployment: no production deployment
- Not changed: pull request heads remain untrusted input

## Verification

- Conformance fixtures — local runner — passed
- Unverified: none

Risk: high — changes repository policy enforcement
